d:
'Hosanna' from the movie 'Ekk Deewana Tha' sung by Leon Dsouza and Suzanne D'Mello features Prateik Babar . While the music soothes your senses, the purity in A.R. Rahman's voice will enchant you. This Bollywood romantic drama written and directed by Gautham Menon features Prateik Babbar and Amy Jackson, while she makes her Bollywood debut.
Song Name - Hosanna
Movie - Ekk Deewana Tha
Singer - Leon D'souza & Suzanne D'Mello
Composer - A.R. Rahman
Lyricists - Javed Akhtar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
